root_cause: Control-flow misalignment between gemm8x8x32_bias_relu_top and postproc_relu_bias: top asserts start_post only after compute_done, while postproc requires active=1 at time of acc_valid to capture data. Since acc_valid occurs during compute, postproc misses the full stream, mem_out is never populated, and output_streamer emits no 64-beat frame.

evidence.observation: test_directed_basic fails at 207000ns with AssertionError: Expected 64 outputs, got 0
evidence.relevance: Earliest deterministic functional failure; explains timeout symptom.

evidence.observation: ST_COMPUTE transitions to ST_POST and asserts start_post only when compute_done is true
evidence.relevance: Postprocess activation occurs after acc stream production window.

evidence.observation: acc_valid is only captured inside if(active); active is set by start_post
evidence.relevance: Any acc_valid before start_post is dropped; no buffering/ready handshake exists.
